title: Fix agentic pull request review failures
body:
The [failed PR review run](https://github.com/remix-run/react-router/actions/runs/34892250438) stopped after an acknowledgment with no safe output, then failed because a skipped threat scan still required an unavailable `threat-detect` binary. This change restores the administrator-request guidance and reports an incomplete review directly.

- Use runtime-supported conditions in the shared request prompt so routed and native comments retain their request instructions.
- Tell the reviewer to continue through the GitHub tool calls and safe output, and fail the agent job if it exits without a safe output.
- Select inline threat detection as a workaround for the regression introduced in [github/gh-aw#50854](https://github.com/github/gh-aw/pull/50854). Threat detection remains enabled with `continue-on-error: false`.
- Regenerate the PR review workflow and refresh the four other command workflow hashes affected by the shared prompt.

**Testing**

- All five command workflows compiled with strict validation.
- 16 focused local checks passed against gh-aw v0.88.7 runtime modules and the generated workflow steps, covering request rendering, detection results, and missing or present safe outputs.
- A live Actions run of the changed workflow is still pending. The precise cause of the original agent's early exit remains unconfirmed; the new completion check makes that failure visible.
